headline: Hunter Green ($175) is correct once tenure is measured from the on-file account date; the customer's claim of "mid-July" is a resolvable red herring.

issues.summary: The customer says she opened her first account in mid-July (about 4 months, which would clear World Blue's 90-day tenure), but the DB shows her earliest checking account opened 09/10/2025, 65 days ago. The documents say tenure comes from the earliest checking account, so the DB settles it.
evidence: user instruction 5: "I opened my first account with Rho-Bank back in mid-July this year. So it's been... about four months now?"
doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_047: "calculated from when you first became a Rho-Bank checking customer—specifically, the date your earliest checking account was opened"
doc_business_checking_accounts_world_blue_001: "at least 90 days"; hunter_green_001: "A minimum relationship duration of 60 days"
issues.why_it_matters: An agent that trusts the customer recommends World Blue ($300) and fails. A careful agent reads date_opened, so the correct final state is unambiguous.
issues.suggested_fix: None required; optionally have the customer say "a couple of months" so the trap tests verification without a factual contradiction.

solution_check: Tenure 65 days. Eligible with $31,000: Hunter Green $175 (60-day tenure), Sky Blue $150 (45 days; LLC just formed), Cobalt Blue $150 (60 days), Navy Blue $100 (60 days). World Blue, Lime Green, True Blue, and Beige need 90+ days. No referrals on file. Hunter Green is the unique maximum and matches gold[3].
prior_note: Same Minor as before: the customer's tenure misstatement is resolvable from the DB.
notes: gold[1]-[2] get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 is a required read (allowlisted); replay shows skipping it fails even under the verified scorer.
